source_policy: 枪范围副目标由50%到80%、甄单体周围4敌/范围目标+4及五式秘籍原说明保留；概率/半径/成长曲线/派生限制/计时为项目采用。

spear_secondary_multiplier.effective_secondary_bp_formula: min(8000,5000+150*effective_grade); grade20 reaches8000, higher legal grade excess explicitly unused
spear_secondary_multiplier.operation: replace exact secondary multiplier once, not multiply8000 over already5000. Other class/skill explicit100percent secondary profile remains intact and cannot silently be reclassified5000.
spear_secondary_multiplier.missing_or_other_secondary_policy: formal spear-area definition must specify compatibility; source unknown or missing base secondary field rejects formal export, not default reduction
spear_secondary_multiplier.stage: after ordinary direct damage computations before target final percent protections, using unscaled per-target amount, apply its named secondary rate once; no second multiplier on already processed damage
spear_secondary_multiplier.root_primary_dead_or_outside_shape: no other target promoted to primary just to gain100percent

zhen_extra_four.draw_time: accepted cast after all admission checks before selecting target list; once per action, pay/cooldown and random result same receipt
zhen_extra_four.single_target_branch: on first actualHPdamage of original primary, one splash event to up to4other enemies within5000mm of primary hit position; no primary duplicate. No actual hit -> no splash, no second roll.
zhen_extra_four.area_branch: increase each declared hit ordinal target capacity exactly4 after original base recipient selection; select additional unique valid targets within original area shape, no new radius
zhen_extra_four.recipient_order: original valid primary first, base secondary distance/id, then4extra distance/id from remaining. Deduplicate actor IDs per hit ordinal; no duplicate award for multi hurt boxes
zhen_extra_four.extra_damage: same accepted action attack/flat-power/phase snapshot and target-specific modifiers; each extra target own accuracy/mitigation, crit disabled by project; derived-no-offensive-procs tag prevents recursion
zhen_extra_four.secondary_extra_does_not_refill_base_slo: base candidates snapshot/declared impact scope; absent candidates yield fewer hits, never synthesize targets
zhen_extra_four.finishing_or_combo_classification: root original explicit single/area/finishing/combo labels unchanged; passive splash never changes quest challenge label

classification: single/area comes from the original ability target-policy ID and declared native capacity, not number of actual enemies or ultimate hits. Single hit1 plus4splash remains single for10turn test; native area hitting1 remains area. Missing label rejects formal ability configuration.
persistence: accepted per-action proc snapshot, primary,selected unique IDs/root/extra ordinals,queued splash center/remaining and emitted receipts recorded. Ordinary save waits root descendants; activity snapshot preserves all. No replay redraw/reselection after receipt.
scope: does not mark all spear/Zhen official abilities adopted. Their original target caps/geometry/secondary multipliers still need explicit per-source phase definitions; no runtime feature claim.
